data.one_liner: Enhanced CupertinoContextMenu with custom top/bottom widgets, programmatic control, and styling options.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Cupertino-style context menu that supports custom widgets above and below the preview, programmatic opening/closing, and extensive styling of the backdrop and actions sheet. It replaces the default Flutter CupertinoContextMenu with additional flexibility.
use_when: Need a context menu with custom actions or UI beyond the default list
Require programmatic control to open the menu from a button or gesture
Want to customize backdrop blur, barrier color, or disable the grow animation
Need consistent alignment in chat bubbles or other UI layouts
avoid_when: Using older Flutter (<3.44) or still relying on package:flutter/cupertino.dart
Project already uses cupertino_ui but cannot upgrade to Dart 3.12+
strengths: Supports custom backdrop blur and barrier color
weaknesses: Breaking change in 2.0.0 may affect existing codebases
No direct alternative in pub.dev list
data.setup_notes: Add cupertino_ui to pubspec, run `dart fix --apply --code=migrate_design_widgets` if migrating from flutter/cupertino.dart
